goal: Bounded product checkpoint; shadow only. No production selection, external power claim or force-spending.
decisions: conservative optional payments, state-aware tutors fixed throughout; no tutor-policy optimization
assumptions: Opening seven, no mulligan, T1 draw, T8 horizon, three inert forty-life opponents. Stage 8 actual-state checkpoints. Engine exile targets shared Undead Augur after deployment; wipe waits for commander. Unknown relevant rules abstain. No inserted cards, forced opening or scripted cohort.
coupling: commonIdentityOrder: independent hash priority per canonical card identity and occurrence. Common cards retain relative order; additions are not forced into cut slots. Membership and downstream shuffles still alter absolute hands/events.
analysis: All fixed policies and both partitions retained. Paired terminal incidence keeps unknown identification bounds; T3/T5/T7 nonterminal metrics use disclosed mutually observed subsets. Prefix death/draw/sacrifice counts are descriptive, not unknown-imputed complete outcomes. Report opportunity incidence separately from matched-prefix conditional +2 turn recovery, including censoring. Bootstrap intervals describe this sampled model, with no universal score or post-hoc pilot winner.
decisionGate: No production promotion from a partial native model. Require credible coherent benefits beyond one commander without hard-gate loss and without material known regressions. If not established, stop expanding simulation solely to increase counts and shift to generator/source quality, manual external comparisons and release review.
scope: Wilhelt original and two declared semantic packages, Ulalek B3/B4 original plus Stage 6 C1/C2 control regressions; Yuriko/Zada control and native abstention. Small sample is deliberately bounded, not a powered universal deck-strength study.

recipes.rationale: Replace redundant bodies/expensive conditional sacrifice with actual nontoken death access, a zero-mana reusable scry outlet and early expendable Zombie. Loss of Horde's activated combat protection is a real unmodeled tradeoff. Protect existing supported death/access/native sources and every standard package gate.

Enchantment death and tribal-entry access remain after creature wipes, plus paid filtering/fixing rock. Trade bodies and combat/counter/discard effects for access redundancy. BBB/3UU setup, life costs and loss of creatures are actual risks; no claim of free reliable draw or recursion.
